title: Remove the generated password from the CreateDBUserTool result
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/tools/atlas/create/createDBUser.ts (lines 84-96 at aaa72a04), change the success content so it never interpolates the generated password. Return only the username, roles and a note that a password was generated. Deliver the secret out-of-band: either require the caller to supply the password (no auto-generation) or store the generated value in AWS Secrets Manager (company secretsManagement.backend) and return only its locator. Keep the session.keychain.register call. Add a unit test next to the existing atlas tool tests asserting the tool result text does not contain the generated value. Constraints: normal change under sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess (1 approval, rollback plan required, promote dev -> qa -> prod). No deploymentWindows or changeFreeze are recorded for mcp-gateway environments. Due before the finding SLA of 2026-09-21T13:14:50Z.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -n 'with password' src/tools/atlas/create/createDBUser.ts` in the mongodb-mcp-server checkout returns no match
A unit test that calls the tool with auto-generated password enabled asserts the returned content text does not contain the generated password and passes in `pnpm test`
Re-running probe-schemas produces no SCH-API-06 fail result at src/tools/atlas/create/createDBUser.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expect no SCH-API-06 result for src/tools/atlas/create/createDBUser.ts and fingerprint 58e52ab0... absent, so the ledger can resolve fnd_01M2G2AGTH64FMR4XR77ZAJH7B.

rootCause.description: The tool builds its success message with the auto-generated password interpolated into the JSON-RPC result. Keychain redaction only scrubs logger output, not tool-result payloads that reach the MCP client transcript.
